title: Content Creator
intro: We are looking for someone to grow our social presence end to end — LinkedIn and Instagram for Hello Robo. You'll produce content every day.

If you live on these platforms, obsess over what's working this week (not last year), know how to use AI to generate and accelerate content, and can turn a studio's work and ideas into a feed people actually follow — this is for you.
workOn: Produce daily content across LinkedIn and Instagram: posts, carousels, stories, reels.
Build and run the founder's personal brand on LinkedIn — ghostwriting, repurposing his thinking into posts, growing his audience.
Turn our existing assets into content: Robo Radio episodes, client work, design process, studio life, industry takes.
Spot and ride trends fast — formats, audio, hooks, conversations happening in robotics, tech, and design right now.
Shoot and edit video and photo (phone-first is fine; polish matters more than gear).
Own the calendar, posting cadence, and community management (comments, DMs, engagement).
Track performance and iterate — what to double down on, what to kill.
Collaborate with our design team so everything that ships meets our visual bar.
bring: You've personally grown an account or run social for a brand, and can show the results.
You know LinkedIn and Instagram cold — algorithms, formats, what makes people stop scrolling.
Strong design eye. You instinctively know when something looks off-brand or cheap.
Fast, prolific, and low-ego about volume — you'd rather ship 5 things and learn than perfect 1.
Sharp writer with a voice. Hooks, captions, copy.
Comfortable on camera and behind it.
howWeWork: Collaborative — you'll work closely with our design team on visuals and concepts.
Fast-moving — we ship content fast and iterate based on what the data tells us.
applySteps: Links to 3 pieces of content you've made (social posts, videos, anything)
One trend you think is underrated right now (tweet length)
